how_to_apply: Visit the official online recruitment portal on the IIIT Delhi website.
Ensure you meet all eligibility criteria before filling out the application form.
Register and fill out the online application form with accurate details.
Upload required documents and details as specified in the portal.
Pay the non-refundable application fee of INR 590 online if applicable.
Submit the completed application form on or before 28th October 2026 by 5 PM.
Download and print a copy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIIT Delhi Junior Administrative Officer
content_sections.text: Visit the official online recruitment portal on the IIIT Delhi website. Ensure you meet all eligibility criteria before filling out the application form. Register and fill out the online application form with accurate details. Upload required documents and details as specified in the portal. Pay the non-refundable application fee of INR 590 online if applicable. Submit the completed application form on or before 28th October 2026 by 5 PM. Download and print a copy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organisation conducting the Junior Administrative Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi (IIIT Delhi) is conducting this recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available under advertisement number 38/2026 for the Department of Human Centered Design.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for IIIT Delhi Junior Administrative Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 28th October 2026 by 5 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate with a good academic record (minimum 55% marks) and total 3 years of relevant experience, or hold a Degree in Engineering with a good academic record (minimum 55% marks) and total 2 years of relevant experience, or a Post Graduate with a good academic record (minimum 55% marks) and total 1 year of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IIIT Delhi Junior Administrative Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for the post is 32 years, with age relaxations applicable as per Government of India norms and Institute rules.
